python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, json
text=Path('Product Decisions.md').read_text()
before=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:Product Decisions.md'],text=True)
pattern=r'^### (PD-\d+)\. .+\n(?:(?!^### |^## ).*\n?)*'
old={m.group(1):m.group() for m in re.finditer(pattern,before,re.M)}
new={m.group(1):m.group() for m in re.finditer(pattern,text,re.M)}
assert list(new)==list(old)==[f'PD-{i:02}' for i in range(1,38)]
affected={'PD-04','PD-06','PD-07','PD-08','PD-09','PD-13','PD-14','PD-17','PD-18','PD-22','PD-33','PD-34','PD-37'}
assert all(old[key]==new[key] for key in old if key not in affected)
opening=text.split('## Highest-priority product decisions\n',1)[1].split('\n## How to read',1)[0]
assert len(re.findall(r'^\d+\. ',opening,re.M))==9
for key in re.findall(r'\bPD-\d+\b',text): assert key in new
for target in re.findall(r'\]\(<([^>]+)>\)',text): assert Path(target).is_file(),target
assert not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in text.splitlines())
print(json.dumps({'existing_decisions_preserved':len(new),'untouched_decision_bodies':len(old)-len(affected),'priority_principles':9,'source_files_exist':True,'all_PD_references_resolve':True,'final_newline':text.endswith(chr(10))},indent=2))
PY
